Ret & Ben::CI2.formula: IF(OR(AND(OR(BP2=2, BP2="2"), OR(BQ2=0, BQ2="0")), AV2>0), 1, VLOOKUP(anb(BG2, AQ2),BFCFs,anb(J2, AQ2)-53,FALSE))

Separated & Active Vesteds::AL2.formula: DATEVALUE(IF(MONTH(MAX(AJ2+365, AK2))<7, CONCATENATE("7/1/", YEAR(MAX(AJ2+365, AK2))), CONCATENATE("7/1/", YEAR(MAX(AJ2+365, AK2))+1)))

Separated & Active Vesteds::CT2.formula: IF(OR(CI2="0",CI2="9"),CONCATENATE("Joint-and-",CM2*100,"% Survivor Annuity",IF(CI2="0"," with Pop-up","")),IF(CI2="5",CONCATENATE(ROUND(CQ2/12,4),"-Year Certain-and-Continuous Annuity"),"Straight Life Annuity"))

Separated & Active Vesteds::DS2.formula: IF(AND(CI2=CB2, CN2=CQ2),IF(E2="1", 1, DH2),IF(AND(L2>0,L2>DOPT,G2="R"),DH2, IF(AND(F2="DOR",OR(DJ2="OSF", DJ2="OMF")), DR2,DG2)))

Separated & Active Vesteds::ET2.formula: IF(BI2="Y", 0, IF(AND(F2="DOR", BX2<DOTR), AR2, IF(E2="2",ROUND((BS-BH2)*DD2*DF2*DH2*QPSAPercent,2), ROUND((BF2-BH2)*DD2*DF2*IF(AND(L2>DOPT, L2<BX2), DH2, DS2),2))))

Separated & Active Vesteds::GS2.formula: IF(GR2="I", "we corrected the late retirement factor.", IF(GR2="D", "we corrected the late retirement factor.", "NULL"))
